title: Katja Wüstenfeld
passages: Katja Wüstenfeld (née Beer, born 10 October 1976) is a German former biathlete. Beer competed in the women's individual event at the 1998 Winter Olympics.
Her father Manfred Beer was a biathlete who earned a bronze medal for East Germany at the 1976 Winter Olympics. Katja married German biathlete Jan Wüstenfeld in 2010.
